professor_requirement_addressed: choose and validate cluster-aware FNR and FPR procedures under unequal ICCs and realistic cluster-size variation

method.name: WCR-C
method.description: restricted wild-cluster bootstrap-t for a linear probability model with CRV1 studentization

validation.selected_scenarios: hardest current-design scenarios from prior stress/final validation plus small-cluster checks
validation.simulation_gate: no scenario may show a clear anti-conservative signal; operationally the lower endpoint of the Monte Carlo 95% Clopper-Pearson interval must not exceed the nominal one-sided alpha

important: This is a validation of an existing WCR implementation under the professor-guided current exact-matched design, not a new estimand or claim. Passing this gate permits inference freeze and immediate transition to the full cluster type-I/power grid.
